metadata.description: Reederey87 GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 dual-Spark source refresh at fd87969cb43a5ba66573bd2508bc05651fc1579c (2026-09-30), recipe release 1.5.1. Keeps the byte-exact Mia-AiLab TR3 4 bpw primary Model and the source launcher’s exact incoai DFlash2 drafter pin 7d74cdd881ed7e32c31175984a67823127b66cfe (non-commercial, no derivatives). Moves the recipe-owned ARM64 ExLlamaV3 build from 1.4.7 ca13bdd83a1f4a74fd817b88f49509e0f22a9b07 to 1.4.9 5be886578ec80324c2c715269387be2058724b6e; the six EXL3 quant/MoE source files used by this recipe are byte-identical across those pins, preserving the existing fused-kernel/ticket-scheduler ABI. The digest-pinned vLLM base image is unchanged. Refreshes the current GLM/DFlash2 overlay/test closure, retains Vonk’s non-root read-only runtime wrapper and build-time patching, and carries upstream’s default-on sparse-cache-miss metric and prompt-token detail reporting. Default serving remains DFlash2 k=7, TP2 across two Sparks, fp8 KV and the existing context/resource envelope. Upstream’s performance and DFlash2 acceptance evidence is not Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance; local build and runtime qualification remain separate gates. The drafter license terms are shown in its Model document. The target-only Model has no historical drafter dependency; cache preparation uses only this recipe's explicitly selected drafter.
